research_mode: official Home Office sources only; police-recorded-crime open-data schema, outcome data-flow, technical definitions and special-collection linkage gates; no parcel result or safety score claimed

sources.name: Quarterly crime-data revisions
verified_claims: quarterly figures are revised each quarter when crimes are transferred to another force or cancelled
limitations: a published quarter is not necessarily immutable

sources.name: Pre-2019 negative quarterly values
verified_claims: negative quarterly values can occur before 2019 because forces deducted transferred or cancelled crimes from cumulative monthly returns
limitations: negative values are correction mechanics and not negative incidents

sources.name: Outcomes framework introduction
verified_claims: the outcomes framework was introduced in April 2013 and replaced the detections regime
limitations: pre-framework detections are not directly equivalent to later outcomes

sources.name: Full outcomes framework coverage
verified_claims: the broader outcomes framework was fully introduced in April 2014
the 2014/15 bulletin was the first publication based entirely on the full framework

sources.name: Quarterly outcomes publication
verified_claims: quarterly outcomes open data have been published since 2014/15
updates have been quarterly since October 2015 following user consultation
limitations: publication cadence does not imply all investigations are final

sources.name: Recorded-period linked outcome view
verified_claims: the recorded-period view links outcomes to individual recorded crimes
it includes an outcome state for investigations that remain open
limitations: open investigations must not be forced into a final outcome

sources.name: First-publication incompleteness
verified_claims: each quarter's linked outcome data provides an incomplete picture when first published
every crime is expected eventually to receive an outcome
limitations: initial snapshots should not be interpreted as final cohort performance

sources.name: Long-running investigation tracking
verified_claims: linked outcome data is particularly useful for tracking sexual offences that can take a long time to reach a final outcome
limitations: later revisions are required for mature comparisons

sources.name: Closed-period outcome view
verified_claims: outcomes closed in the latest period can relate to crimes recorded in previous years
limitations: the numerator and same-year crime denominator may cover different cohorts

sources.name: Illustrative outcome rates over 100 percent
verified_claims: closed-period outcome rates can exceed 100% for some low-volume crime types
such rates are illustrative rather than true cohort rates
limitations: rates over 100% must not be treated as impossible data or direct performance scores

sources.name: Monthly outcome-data submissions
verified_claims: the Home Office receives monthly crime, outcome and transferred/cancelled data from police forces
fraud and Computer Misuse Act offences are excluded from this force submission stream
limitations: the data flow does not cover all centrally recorded fraud and cybercrime

sources.name: Anomaly validation workflow
verified_claims: Home Office statisticians analyse submissions and return anomaly or error reports to the relevant force for validation or correction
limitations: quality assurance can identify issues but does not guarantee error-free data

sources.name: Pre-publication force verification
verified_claims: before publication, Home Office data are returned to all forces for confirmation against their systems
forces resubmit data where required
limitations: force confirmation is a verification control, not independent remeasurement

sources.name: Home Office Data Hub record-level source
verified_claims: the Home Office Data Hub allows forces to provide record-level detail on offences
record-level supply expands analytical possibilities
limitations: record-level administrative data are still subject to recording and revision limitations

sources.name: Crimsec4 and additional outcome returns
verified_claims: a small number of forces supply an aggregated Crimsec4 return monthly
forces using Crimsec4 provide additional outcomes data quarterly
limitations: mixed source formats can limit uniform record-level analysis
